title: DC新球场获批：5.26亿市政债计划，官方文件未提及，钱从哪来？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The Washington commanders are returning to Washington, DC, and with that move, DC is considering borrowing some $526 million in municipal bonds to help finance a new stadium.
segments.zh: 华盛顿指挥官队将重返华盛顿特区，特区正考虑发行约5.26亿美元市政债券，为新球场融资。

segments.en: So, Ashina Shaw is here with us to give us some more details on this. This new stadium was already approved, right? Yes, this was approved. This project was approved last year, and we've reported
segments.zh: Ashina Shaw来为我们介绍更多细节。新球场已经获批了，对吧？是的，去年就批了，我们报道过

segments.en: that they're going to be issuing potentially a bond sale to fund the finances and construction behind the new commander stadium. And so, this is going to be a 65,000 seat stadium with the roof,
segments.zh: 他们可能发行债券，为指挥官队新球场的融资和建设提供资金。这将是一座6.5万座、带顶棚的球场，

segments.en: and it's going to be built on the grounds of the former RFK Memorial Stadium in DC.
segments.zh: 建在华盛顿特区前RFK纪念体育场原址上。

segments.en: So, the commanders are coming back from Maryland to DC. Okay, and it's not just a football stadium.
segments.zh: 指挥官队将从马里兰回到华盛顿特区。而且这不只是座橄榄球场。

segments.en: There's a lot more to this. It's, you know, got a whole bunch of bells and whistles.
segments.zh: 远不止于此，还有很多配套设施。

segments.en: Yeah, and I think this plays into the broader trend that's happening with a lot of stadium projects around the country. New stadium development projects are going to have sports complexes and
segments.zh: 对，这契合了全国许多球场项目的整体趋势。新球场开发项目会配套体育综合体和

segments.en: entertainment districts. And we're seeing that play out in DC as well. So, there'll be hotels.
segments.zh: 娱乐区。华盛顿特区也是如此。会有酒店，

segments.en: There's going to be restaurants, retail. There's also going to be multi-family housing, which this was part of the agreement between the commanders in DC that about 30% of that housing is going to
segments.zh: 餐厅、零售，还有多户住宅。这是指挥官队与特区协议的一部分，约30%的住宅将

segments.en: go towards affordable housing. So, it's going to be an entertainment district where folks that live in DC or, you know, you've been visiting for a game, residents around there are going to be able to
